log: — Wrackport · Town —
You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
You make your way to Crooked Street.
You make your way to Lantern-Lit Street.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You make your way to Shuttered Market.
The Market trades in materials.
You buy 2 Driftwood at the Market for 4 gold.
You return to Lantern-Lit Street.
You return to Crooked Street.
You make your way to Quiet Street.
You make your way to Salt-Stained Street.
A Salted Buckler lies here.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You make your way to Salt-Stained Tavern.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night and a kitchen.
The fire spits salt.
You return to Salt-Stained Street.
A Salted Buckler lies here.
You return to The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
You take the road to The Bent Wood.
— The Bent Wood · Forest —
You stand at The Forest Edge.
You make your way to Dripping Path.
A Harpoon lies here.
You return to The Forest Edge.
You make your way to Still Hollow.
You gather 2 Hide.
A Wrecker comes upon you!
You hit the Wrecker for 3.
The Wrecker hits you for 4.
You hit the Wrecker for 2.
The Wrecker hits you for 4.
You hit the Wrecker for 3.
The Wrecker hits you for 2.
You hit the Wrecker for 3.
The Wrecker hits you for 4.
You hit the Wrecker for 2.
You defeat the Wrecker.
It drops a Salted Buckler and 5 gold.
You take 1 Iron Ore.
You return to The Forest Edge.
A crow watches from a stump.
You return to Dripping Path.
A Harpoon lies here.
Something moves in the bracken and is still.
You make your way to Wind-Bent Stream.
A Cutlass lies here.
You gather 2 Mushrooms.
You make your way to Whispering Path.
A Wild Boar comes upon you!
You hit the Wild Boar for 5.
The Wild Boar hits you for 2.
You hit the Wild Boar for 5.
The Wild Boar hits you for 4.
You hit the Wild Boar for 3.
You defeat the Wild Boar.
You take 2 Hide.
You take 2 Boar Meat.
You return to Wind-Bent Stream.
A Cutlass lies here.
The stream talks to itself.
You make your way to Misty Glade.
A Sealskin Boots lies here.
You find the Harbourmaster's Ledger. Its pages are stuck together with salt, but the figures are legible.
You make your way to Wind-Bent Path.
